result.title: Baxter Trophy Champions!
result.teaser_html:
Congratulations to our Baxter Trophy team who retained their title this afternoon at Hazel Grove Sports Centre, beating teams from Crewe, Chester and Wirral leagues.

Well played everyone! As winners we will be hosting again this time next year.
Photo L-R: Tom Huggon, Cat Golds, Chris Bellis, James Kee, Greg Mooney, Hannah Hernon, Rachel Flood, Anna Bellis

result.title: Messer Trophy - Group Finals
result.teaser_html:
The Group Finals for the Messer Trophy have now been held. The Messer Group A Final was contested by 1st and 2nd in Division 1, Featherforce and David Lloyd. The match was very close with most of the level doubles being halved leaving the score at 6-6 going into the Mixed. In the mixed games which were also close Featherforce just edged all 3 to take the Trophy 9-6.

The games in the Group B Final between Alderley Park C and College Green C were also close but Alderley Park C took the majority to win 10-5 overall.

result.title: Messer Trophy Final
result.teaser_html:
The Messer Trophy was won this year by Featherforce A who beat Alderley Park C 14-1.
Due to the strength of the Featherforce team who are new to the league this year, they played in the final off a Premier rather than Division 1 handicap but they still proved too much for Alderley Park C with even the one game Alderley won being 21-20.

Well done to both teams for playing the match in an excellent spirit and also to Featherforce A for their league and cup double!

As always - questions / suggestions are always welcome - use the contact us menu to get in touch with me. Neil
